budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fire Chief Sullivan estimated the cost of adding a fourth shift of three Firefighters, including salaries, overtime, holiday pay and one new officer position.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The trash and recycling program is half tax-supported and half bag-fee-supported; the Town Manager said an enterprise structure would shift cost to residents.
budget_items.quote: with half of the program being supported by taxation and the other half being supported by the bag fees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager explained the fee structure for Town Counsel; no dollar amounts were printed.
